_: The armies bar down the left edge (realm/scripts/army_bar.gd; Total War's army list, Age of Empires IV's army panel): a button per host of the King's own, under the date card (and under the great houses while they are open). gap: px between it and what is above it; keep_bottom: px kept clear at the screen's foot (the town card, the news); width: each button's width in px. Words: place, the host's top line ({town} where it stands); field, with no town under it; troops, its strength ({men}); tip, the button's words on hover; selected, the word on a selected host's button (with the thicker outline: never colour alone).
tip: Click: select this host. Shift- or Cmd-click: add it to those selected. Double-click: go to it.

groups._: Groups of hosts (host_command.gd; StarCraft's and Age of Empires' control groups, keys.gd group_1..group_9, changeable in Settings): Cmd+number makes group n of the hosts selected, the number selects them, twice within twice_s seconds the view goes there too. Kept for this sitting only. Words ({n} the number, {count} how many hosts): one / some when a group is made, cleared when Cmd+number is pressed with none selected, empty when a number has no host left in it, badge the line on a host's button.
groups.one: Group {n}: this host. Press {n} to select it, twice to go there.
groups.some: Group {n}: {count} hosts. Press {n} to select them, twice to go there.
groups.empty: No host in group {n}. Select some and press Cmd+{n}.
groups.badge: In group {n}: press {n} to select, twice to go there.
